checker_source:
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
import csv, hashlib, json, re, sys
from pypdf import PdfReader

ROOT = Path("/home/zpz/repos/diff_minimal_meso")
BASE = ROOT / "misc/selective_discreteness_ramp_metering_review"
TEMP = Path("/tmp/rm12_67_joined_receiving_20261008_113903_196795")
snapshot = json.loads((TEMP / "snapshot.json").read_text())
digest = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for rel, h in snapshot["protected"].items():
    assert digest(ROOT / rel) == h, rel

new_md = [
    "reporting/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_findings.md",
    "extraction/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_source_audit.md",
    "synthesis/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_qualification.md",
    "archive/user_supplied/rm12_bp_r_stage3/own_motion_source_request.md",
]
documents = snapshot["mutable"] + new_md
links = 0
for rel in documents:
    p = BASE / rel
    content = p.read_text()
    assert not re.search(r"\)\+(?:and|gives|contain|separate)", content), rel
    for match in re.finditer(r"\[[^\]\n]*\]\((<[^>]+>|[^)\n]+)\)", content):
        target = match.group(1).strip("<>")
        if re.match(r"https?://|mailto:", target):
            continue
        path, _, fragment = target.partition("#")
        destination = (p.parent / path).resolve() if path else p
        assert destination.exists(), (rel, target)
        links += 1
        if fragment and destination.suffix == ".md":
            text = destination.read_text()
            headings = set()
            for line in text.splitlines():
                if re.match(r"^#{1,6} ", line):
                    heading = re.sub(r"^#{1,6} ", "", line).lower()
                    heading = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 _-]", "", heading).strip()
                    headings.add(heading.replace(" ", "-"))
            assert fragment in headings, (rel, target)

plan = (BASE / "rm12_67_bp_r_stage3_control_birth_adequacy_continuation.md").read_text()
assert "**Closed as A:**" in plan
assert "ACT.C is deferred" in plan
assert "S3-I2.SRC" in plan and "Type 1" in plan
report = (BASE / new_md[0]).read_text()
for token in ["SRC.A", "SRC.B", "prescribed-path", "not a demand to redesign", "Stage 3 remains open"]:
    assert token in report, token

u, w, kappa = F(30), F(5), F(3, 20)
Q = u*w*kappa/(u+w)
trace = lambda v: w*kappa*v/(w+v)
groups = []
cases = 0
for i in range(151):
    v = F(i, 5)
    assert 0 <= trace(v) <= Q
    for t in [F(0), F(1, 3), F(15)]:
        tau = t*w/(w+v)
        assert tau + v*tau/w == t
        assert kappa*v*tau == trace(v)*t
        cases += 1
groups.append({"group": "constant-path wave/count identity and capacity", "cases": cases})

phi = lambda tau: 5*tau if tau <= 10 else 15*tau-100
inverse = lambda t: t/2 if t <= 20 else (t+20)/4
envelope = lambda t: 3*t/8 if t <= 20 else 9*t/16-F(15,4)
cases = 0
for i in range(121):
    t = F(i, 2)
    tau = inverse(t)
    assert tau + phi(tau)/w == t
    assert kappa*phi(tau) == envelope(t)
    assert 0 <= envelope(t) <= Q*t
    for s in {F(0), min(t, F(20)), t}:
        assert envelope(s) + Q*(t-s) >= envelope(t)
    cases += 1
assert inverse(F(15)) == F(15, 2)
assert envelope(F(15)) == F(45, 8)
assert trace(F(15)) == F(9, 16)
assert F(3,8)*10 + F(9,16)*5 - envelope(F(15)) == F(15,16)
assert envelope(F(20)) == F(15,2)
groups.append({"group": "piecewise prescribed-path delay, envelope and shortcut discrepancy", "cases": cases})

idle = lambda t: F(0) if t <= 10 else min(Q*(t-10), F(3,8)*t)
attempt = lambda t: Q*max(F(0), t-10)
cases = 0
for i in range(101):
    t = F(i, 2)
    C = idle(t)
    assert 0 <= C <= F(3,8)*t
    breakpoints = {F(0), min(F(10),t), t}
    variational = min(F(3,8)*s + attempt(t)-attempt(s) for s in breakpoints)
    assert C == variational
    if t <= 24:
        assert C == attempt(t)
    else:
        assert C == F(3,8)*t
    cases += 1
assert Q*(24-10) == F(3,8)*24 == 9
assert idle(F(12)) == F(9,7) and Q > trace(F(5))
groups.append({"group": "idle-then-burst cumulative constraint, slack and exact catch time", "cases": cases})

cases = 0
for dr in [F(0),F(1,20),F(1,8),F(1,4),F(3,8),F(1),F(3)]:
    for dm in [F(0),F(1,20),F(1,8),F(1,4),F(3,8),F(1),F(3)]:
        for R in [F(0),F(1,8),F(3,8),F(1)]:
            for p in [F(0),F(1,3),F(1,2),F(1)]:
                if dr+dm <= R:
                    fr, fm = dr, dm
                else:
                    fr = min(dr, max(p*R,R-dm))
                    fm = R-fr
                assert 0 <= fr <= dr and 0 <= fm <= dm
                assert fr+fm == min(dr+dm,R)
                assert -fr-fm+(fr+fm) == 0
                cases += 1
groups.append({"group": "N.A scarcity/reallocation bounds and paired conservation", "cases": cases})

cases = 0
for a0 in [F(1),F(3),F(4)]:
    for dt in [F(1,10),F(1,2),F(1)]:
        vmax = F(40)
        assert 0 < a0*dt/vmax <= 1
        vstar = min(u,a0*dt)
        assert vstar > 0
        for v in [vstar,F(10),F(20),u]:
            next_v = min(u,v+a0*(1-v/vmax)*dt)
            assert vstar <= v <= next_v <= u
            cases += 1
groups.append({"group": "conditional free-motion lower-speed bound (local algebra only)", "cases": cases})

pdf = BASE / "synthesis/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_math.pdf"
tex = pdf.with_suffix(".tex")
assert pdf.read_bytes() == (TEMP/"tex/joined_receiving_math.pdf").read_bytes()
reader = PdfReader(pdf)
pdf_text = "\n".join(p.extract_text() for p in reader.pages)
assert len(reader.pages) == 3
assert tex.read_text().count(r"\begin{equation}") == 16
for token in ["Disposition", "Own motion", "Unused receiving", "(16)"]:
    assert token in pdf_text, token
log = (TEMP / "tex/joined_receiving_math.log").read_text()
assert not re.search(r"Warning|Overfull|Underfull|^!", log, flags=re.M)

queries = list(csv.DictReader((BASE/"search/rm12_bp_r_stage3_joined_receiving_queries.csv").open()))
activities = list(csv.DictReader((BASE/"screening/rm12_bp_r_stage3_joined_receiving_sources.csv").open()))
assert len(queries) == 8
assert len({r["batch"] for r in queries}) == 4
assert len(activities) == 16
assert sum(r["activity"].startswith("technical_") for r in activities) == 5
assert sum(r["activity"] == "failed_access" for r in activities) == 4

allowed_new = set(new_md + [
    "synthesis/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_math.tex",
    "synthesis/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_math.pdf",
    "search/rm12_bp_r_stage3_joined_receiving_queries.csv",
    "screening/rm12_bp_r_stage3_joined_receiving_sources.csv",
    "reporting/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_execution_validation.json",
])
baseline = set(snapshot["baseline_files"])
new_files = {str(p.relative_to(BASE)) for p in BASE.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) not in baseline}
assert new_files <= allowed_new, new_files-allowed_new
result = {
    "status":"PASS",
    "date":"2026-10-08",
    "scope":"Static exact-rational analytical identities and document/source/build preservation. No traffic/gradient simulation.",
    "protected_files":len(snapshot["protected"]),
    "checked_documents":len(documents),
    "local_links":links,
    "analytical_groups":groups,
    "source_queries":len(queries),
    "source_query_batches":4,
    "source_activity_rows":len(activities),
    "source_technical_objects":5,
    "source_failed_access_routes":4,
    "pdf_pages":len(reader.pages),
    "pdf_equations":16,
    "pdf_inspection":"Extracted text and build log; no raster inspection claimed.",
    "python_version":sys.version,
    "pypdf_version":__import__("pypdf").__version__,
    "latex_version":"pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.25, TeX Live 2023/Debian",
    "snapshot":str(TEMP/"snapshot.json"),
    "checker_path":__file__,
    "checker_sha256":digest(Path(__file__)),
    "checker_source":Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "commands":[
        "pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory="+str(TEMP/"tex")+" "+str(tex.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "/home/zpz/miniconda3/envs/differential_sim/bin/python /tmp/validate_rm12_joined_receiving.py",
    ],
    "current_status":"Q.ACT A approved; Step 67/Stage 3 open at source-input discussion. Full law and Stage 4 unadopted.",
    "limitations":[
        "Prescribed isolated path diagnostic, not a source-generated metering/TST witness.",
        "Full J01 own-motion journal algorithm not read; accessible 2003 predecessor is not substituted.",
        "General motion/node/source/coincidence, clearance and useful gradients remain unqualified.",
    ],
    "changed_and_new_hashes":{rel:digest(BASE/rel) for rel in documents + sorted(allowed_new-{"reporting/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_execution_validation.json"}) if (BASE/rel).exists()},
}
output = BASE/"reporting/rm12/bp_r_stage3/joined_receiving_execution_validation.json"
if output.exists():
    assert sys.argv[1:] == ["--refresh-current"], "Existing evidence is preserved unless this current-task refresh is explicit."
    previous = json.loads(output.read_text())
    assert previous["snapshot"] == str(TEMP/"snapshot.json") and previous["status"] == "PASS"
    mode = "w"
else:
    mode = "x"
with output.open(mode) as f:
    json.dump(result,f,indent=2)
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ["status","protected_files","checked_documents","local_links","analytical_groups","pdf_pages","pdf_equations"]},indent=2))
